title: Sanction of Central Government for warehousing of arms.―Notwithstanding anything
text:
34. Sanction of Central Government for warehousing of arms.―Notwithstanding anything

contained in the [Customs Act, 1962 (52 of 1962),] no arms or ammunition shall be deposited in any
warehouse licensed under [section 58] of that Act without the sanction of the Central Government.
